id.description: Optional client-generated UUID identifying a position report. Used to recognise offline retries and prevent duplicate processing.

activationId.description: The activation the steward saw when making the report. A report against an activation that is no longer active is rejected with 409 E1003.

taskDone.description: True when the steward has finished the task at the station (MET-A-015). Only allowed at the station of the steward's latest report.

event.description: What the report says about the steward at the station (MET-A-015). EN_ROUTE: on the way, the default when left out. ARRIVED: arrived, only after EN_ROUTE at the same station. CANCELLED: no longer on the way, only after EN_ROUTE at the same station; the station is free again. CHECKED_OUT: left the station after arriving, only after ARRIVED or taskDone at the same station. The station must be the one in the steward's latest report for every event except EN_ROUTE. Anything else is rejected with E1006. Sending the same event again is a harmless repeat. Cannot be sent together with taskDone. EN_ROUTE at the station of the steward's latest report, while on the way or arrived there, is a harmless repeat and does not change the status. EN_ROUTE to another station while on the way changes the steward's mind: the old station is freed as with CANCELLED. After arriving or finishing the task at a station, EN_ROUTE to another station is rejected with E1006: the steward checks out first, then reports the new station.
